accepted.sentence: A rigid metal shaft extends from a thicker handle, ending in a tip shaped to engage a fastener.
The handle is commonly molded from plastic, sometimes with a soft rubberized layer for improved grip.
The working shaft is often made of hardened steel to resist bending and wear during use.
Raised ribs or textured patterns on the handle surface can help prevent a hand from slipping.
Some models accept removable tips that attach to the shaft, allowing different working profiles to be fitted.
A magnetized tip can hold a small metal fastener in place while it is being positioned.
In some designs, an internal mechanism lets the handle turn while the shaft remains engaged with a fastener.
The shaft may be straight or bent near its handle, changing the angle at which its tip reaches a fastener.
